run_compute_scaling_factors: run compute_scaling_factors to fit and save model scale factors to a checkpoint file
run_fit_cli: run the fit CLI module with --checkpoint and config args to compute scaling factors
run_train_batch: run _train_batch to perform a forward pass and loss computation on a single batch
review_compute_scaling_factors: review compute_scaling_factors to understand how scale factors are discovered, sorted, and fitted
refactor_train_batch: refactor _train_batch to support a different forward pass or loss computation strategy
